title: Constant-rank determinant description of the smooth diagonal dualizing object
statement: Let S be a Noetherian scheme (locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] and quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme]), and let f:X\to S be proper [def-weil-proper-morphism] and smooth of relative dimension d\geq0 [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Put P=X\times_S X with diagonal \Delta:X\to P [def-pc-base-change]. Choose derived categories for X and P, possibly in different universes [def-pc-derived-category]. Let h_\Delta witness preservation of quasi-coherent cohomology by the recorded R\Delta_* [def-pc-derived-direct-image], and let c:D_{QCoh}(P)\to D_{QCoh}(X) be a specified right adjoint of its full-subcategory restriction using h_\Delta. Let O_P be a quasi-coherent derived object with underlying object isomorphic to \mathcal O_P[0]. Write M=\Omega^1_{X/S} [def-sc-relative-differential-sheaf] and M^\vee=\mathcal Hom(M,\mathcal O_X) [def-pur-sheaf-hom]. Then there is an isomorphism c(O_P)\cong (\bigwedge^d M^\vee)[-d] in D(X), with the sheafified exterior power [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power].

proof.text: Properness makes the diagonal closed. Mathlib gives local Noetherianness and quasi-compactness of X and of the fibre product from the finite type morphisms to the Noetherian base. Apply the smooth-diagonal regular-generators theorem at each diagonal point. Convert its regular list to a Koszul-regular sequence indexed by Fin. In the unit-ideal alternative use the singleton 1: its weak regularity and the tensor-unit comparison give Koszul regularity. Hom.ker_apply identifies the affine section kernel with the ideal used by Koszul duality. No perfectness assertion or derived category on every open is needed.

The ideal-sheaf conormal comparison provides its isomorphism with relative differentials and its stalk finrank d. Thus the constant locally constant function d supplies the rank witness for Koszul duality.

Use hOP and quasi-coherence of OP to lift the literal single structure object O into the full subcategory. The same underlying isomorphism gives OP isomorphic to this lift. Repackage hRDelta as the preservation witness on underlying objects and apply koszulRegularImmersion_dualizing to the specified c and adjC at the literal lift. Map the OP isomorphism through c, and forget the resulting full-subcategory isomorphisms.

Apply the internal Hom functor contravariantly to the inverse conormal isomorphism, obtaining an isomorphism of the two dual module sheaves. The constant-rank exterior comparison identifies the localized exterior complex with the degree-zero single of the exterior power of the dual differentials shifted by -d. Compose the OP transport, the inverse Koszul duality isomorphism and this comparison.

The upstream theorem uses the canonical exteriorPower implementation. To recover the archived exteriorSheaf conclusion, rewrite with exteriorSheaf_eq_exteriorPower. This equality follows from equality of the sectionwise exterior presheaves and the same sheafification functor, without freeness or nonempty hypotheses. The restored compatibility module checks this entire archived signature in Lean.
